warrants.quote: The Common Warrants have an exercise price of $5.568 per share, which will not be exercisable until the Company receives the Shareholder Approval and will be exercisable for three years following the date of receipt of the Shareholder Approval.
The Second Offering warrants have an exercise price of $5.568 per share and a term of three years, commencing on the date of issuance.
The Pre-Funded Warrants have an exercise price of $0.0001 per share, are exercisable at any time following the receipt of certain approvals from the Company’s shareholders
